Got your hands on Claude Fable 5 yet?

Run this Repo Audit & Project Improvement Prompt (made by Fable 5 itself) on every important repo. Simply copy-paste it.  

Prompt: 

You are a world-class principal-level software engineer and technical auditor with Mythos-class capabilities.

Your job: deeply analyze this repository, give a brutally honest audit, and deliver a prioritized, actionable improvement plan that turns good projects into god-tier ones.

Work strictly in these four phases, in order. Do not skip ahead.

Phase 1: Discovery & Mapping
- Explore the entire codebase
- Build a clear repo map with core components, architecture, and dependencies
- Identify key files and flows

Phase 2: Audit Report
- Ground every claim in actual files: cite file paths and line numbers
- Severity: Critical / High / Medium / Low
- Distinguish facts from judgments
- Prefer 15 high-confidence findings over 50 speculative ones
- Executive Summary with A–F grade + top risks/opportunities

Phase 3: Improvement Strategy
- Prioritized quick wins and long-term upgrades
- Pareto focus: core 20% that moves the needle
- Calibrate to the project's current maturity

Phase 4: Detailed Task Plan
- Concrete tasks with effort estimates (S/M/L/XL)
- Measurable "done" signals
- Milestones and handoff points

Do NOT modify any code during this audit.
If the project is healthy, say so in one sentence.

Pro tip: Feed it your whole repo context or key folders + this prompt → Fable 5 will hand you a professional-grade roadmap in one shot. Vibe coders, builders & degens — this is the multiplier you’ve been waiting for.

Hey #OAX fam!

This week, Anthropic launched #Claude #Fable 5, the first version of its #Mythos-class model that anyone can access. 🤖 Until now, Mythos was locked to a small circle of approved orgs managing critical infrastructure across 15 countries.

Here's why this release is worth paying attention to 👇

🧠 Big capability, hard guardrails. 

Fable 5 reportedly shines at software engineering, knowledge work, and vision. But in high-risk areas - cybersecurity, biology, chemistry - it blocks responses and falls back to Claude Opus 4.8. Anthropic says this is rare though: ~95% of sessions run fully on Fable.

💰 Premium pricing. 

$10 per million input tokens, $50 per million output, this is double the cost of Opus 4.8. And this lands right as enterprises everywhere are side-eyeing their AI bills.

🔒 A new data-retention precedent. 

All Fable 5 and Mythos 5 traffic comes with mandatory 30-day retention - even for enterprises that previously had zero-retention agreements. #Anthropic says it won't train on the data, only use it to defend against novel attacks and jailbreaks. Whether other labs follow this playbook is one of the bigger questions here 🤔

📅 Staged rollout. 

Fable 5 is included in Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans through June 22 - after that, it switches to usage credits, with subscription access returning later.

The bigger picture: this launch comes just days after Anthropic publicly called for frontier labs to coordinate a "brake pedal" on AI development, and as the company gears up for the public markets. 

Shipping your most powerful model while warning about where the tech is headed? That tension is quickly becoming the defining dynamic in AI right now. 😅

For teams across #Asia evaluating frontier models, the question has shifted from "what can it do?" to "what conditions come with it?" 

Full story via TechCrunch: https://t.co/x1IoeIlJui

Claude Fable 5 has been out for 3 days and it's already the most unhinged week AI has ever had.

I'm not exaggerating. People aren't "testing" this model — they're typing one sentence and getting back entire products.

A full Pokémon game. 8,000 lines. One prompt.
3D worlds running in the browser.
A live city simulator with traffic and tracking.
Minecraft in HTML… that added its own soundtrack.

One prompt. One hour of thinking. Zero edits. Code that just works.

A senior engineer who tried it called it his "personal singularity moment" — and said he's more concerned than happy.

I collected the 10 most insane builds from this week so you don't have to.

Buckle up

If you want to try Fable 5, get the x5 or x20 tier. 

I maxed out my x5 weekly limit and loaded $50 in credits to see how far it'd go... but doing mathematical physics blew all that cash in just 3 prompts! 💀 Got ~160 prompts total on the tier before maxing out. 

Choose wisely!

→ https://t.co/pLX4PR4Ku6 🎯 Fable 5 trading WC autonomously needs cross-venue PM data — Polymarket + Kalshi + Limitless + Myriad + Opinion + 3 more all price the same matches differently. Single-venue agent = leaving structural alpha on the table. 8-venue unified schema gives autonomous agents the full battle map 🔥

CLAUDE FABLE 5 IS PLAYING A DIFFERENT GAME

Same prompts, same tasks, same rules, yet the outputs don't even feel like they came from the same generation of AI. While other models produced decent simulations, Claude Fable 5 generated scenes that look closer to finished products than experiments. The fluid simulation has more depth, the lunar environment feels like an actual game world, and the black hole render looks like something pulled from a modern visualization engine rather than a chatbot response.

What's interesting isn't that one model won a benchmark. It's that the gap is becoming visible without charts, scores, or leaderboards. You can see it instantly. When people can identify the stronger model from a few seconds of video, the conversation shifts from "which AI is best" to "how far ahead is it"

The most dangerous thing about AI progress is that it happens gradually, then all at once. This video feels a lot like one of those moments.

AI Architect's Daily Briefing - June 12, 2026

AI moves fast. Here are five stories dominating feeds this week. As a Solution Architect, I break down the practical impact under each.

1. Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5 (public Mythos-class model) and restricted Mythos 5.

This frontier model excels at long-horizon agentic tasks, coding, and reasoning. It leads benchmarks like SWE-Bench while adding strong safety controls for public use.

Solution Architect's Take:  Deploy Fable 5 for complex enterprise workflows like autonomous codebases or multi-step planning. Start with data foundations and monitoring to handle context windows and rate limits effectively. It accelerates delivery but demands robust orchestration.

2. Jeff Bezos' Prometheus raises billions at massive valuation for "artificial general engineer."

The startup builds AI for designing and manufacturing physical products in aerospace, chips, and more. Bezos serves as co-CEO.

Solution Architect's Take: This shifts AI from digital to physical domains. Integrate similar world models into supply chain and engineering pipelines for simulation-driven design. Expect faster prototyping but plan for hybrid human-AI governance in manufacturing systems.

3. Visa integrates payment network into ChatGPT for AI agent shopping.

AI agents can now recommend and complete retail purchases securely via Visa rails.

Solution Architect's Take: Agentic commerce is here. Architect secure APIs, authentication, and transaction guardrails for AI-driven buying. Focus on compliance, user consent, and fallback mechanisms to scale this without fraud spikes.

4. Siri gets major AI upgrade powered by Google Gemini.

Apple partners with Google for a smarter, more personalized Siri rollout.

Solution Architect's Take: Multimodal assistants improve user experiences on devices. Design privacy-first integrations with on-device and cloud boundaries. Test for reliability in voice workflows and prepare ecosystems for hybrid AI partnerships.

5. McDonald’s tests Google-backed AI drive-thru ordering system.
 
AI handles customer orders at scale in real restaurants.

Solution Architect's Take: Real-world agent deployment in high-volume ops. Build resilient systems with speech recognition, context handling, and human escalation. Measure latency, accuracy, and ROI before enterprise-wide rollout.

These stories show AI agents and physical integration accelerating. Stay focused on architecture that delivers value safely.
